description: Spectra whose values legitimately fall outside the validator's hard bounds, or otherwise need a named per-spectrum check waived. Every entry must say why. Entries that no longer match any issue are reported as stale warnings so this list shrinks as loaders are fixed. Format: see openspeclib.validate.AllowlistEntry.

entries.reason: Published by USGS as-is: a ratio-like test spectrum (wavelength-shifted LawnGrass, values ~1.0 from 0.3 to 2.3 um rather than a grass reflectance curve). Its 2.014 peak is a single noisy point in the 2.75 um water band. Not a scale error; bound raised to 2.1 so any real rescale still fails.
